# Abrar - Full-Stack Engineer & Product Builder
> Portfolio context for AI agents, LLMs, and crawlers.

## Bio
Abrar is a Full-Stack & Applied AI Engineer building high-performance web applications, distributed systems, and modern developer tooling.

## Primary Tech Stack
- Frontend: React 19, Next.js (App Router), TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion
- Backend: Node.js, Bun, Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Redis
- DevOps: Docker, Cloudflare, GitHub Actions, Linux/VPS self-hosting

## Key Projects
- SubAgents Hub: Curated AI sub-agent prompts and Model Context Protocol (MCP) server directory.
- RequestFlow Simulator: Interactive topology visualizer tracing requests through gateway, cache, and database layers.
- ClipForge AI: Automated video transcription and multi-platform clip generation pipeline using Whisper and Remotion.
- Is-A.Developer DNS: Automated GitOps subdomain provisioning with GitHub Actions and Cloudflare DNS.
